Who we are

Specialists in technical and engineering talent

We are headhunters who work only on technical roles: software and IT, cybersecurity, and mechanical and industrial engineering. Our screening is technical too, so the candidates you meet have already shown that they can do the work.

We cover the whole talent lifecycle with one team. We map the skills you have, grow junior engineers through our university programme, find the specialists you are missing, bridge gaps with independent professionals and plan who steps into each critical role next.

What we do

Five services, one connected lifecycle

From knowing which skills you have to deciding who comes next, each service builds on the one before it.

  1. Map

    Competence mapping

    Know exactly which skills your engineering teams have, and which ones you are missing.

    Explore competence mapping

  2. Develop

    University talent programme

    Sponsor seats in a cohort and hire juniors who are ready from their first day.

    Explore the university talent programme

  3. Acquire

    Talent acquisition

    Find and hire the engineers and technical specialists you can’t find alone.

    Explore talent acquisition

  4. Bridge

    Temporary staffing

    Cover project peaks and skill gaps with independent engineers and specialists, engaged on a project basis.

    Explore temporary staffing

  5. Secure

    Succession planning

    Make sure every critical technical role has someone ready to step in.

    Explore succession planning

Why us

What sets us apart

  1. 01

    Engineering specialists

    We work only on technical roles, and our screening is technical, so candidates show their skills before you meet them.

  2. 02

    The whole lifecycle, one partner

    Five connected services replace a chain of separate vendors, from mapping skills to planning succession.

  3. 03

    Quality over quantity

    You receive a shortlist of vetted candidates, not a flood of CVs to sort through yourself.

  4. 04

    Talent we build, not just find

    Our university programme trains junior engineers who are ready to contribute from their first day.

  5. 05

    Continuity for critical roles

    Succession planning and independent specialists keep key roles covered through departures, project peaks and leave.
